subject: planner: add tolerance for row count floating point comparison (#59241)
summary: Diff vs first parent updates only planner code paths that compare estimated row counts: introduces `cost.ToleranceFactor` (1e-5) and uses it to avoid tiny floating-point deltas triggering row-count “inconsistency” adjustments in `pkg/planner/core/stats.go` and LIMIT-based row-count scaling for index-merge/table-scan planning in `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go`. This affects cost/cardinality estimation and plan selection, not SQL correctness/privilege/txn/session semantics. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` (at `3b531d4e3d99...`): the tolerance constant remains and the related comparisons persist (with refactors in surrounding stats code), with no follow-up change indicating a correctness or runtime-protocol issue.
